title: Detect stationary offshore infrastructure using monthly 6-month median SAR composites + CFAR
description: Detect offshore infrastructure using the same two-parameter CFAR method as vessel detection but with two modifications: (1) construct median composites from SAR images within a 6-month time window to suppress non-stationary objects (most vessels) and enhance stationary objects; repeat monthly to produce a time series of composites; (2) use reduced spatial windows to reduce contamination from dense clusters of structures (e.g., wind farms). The paper reports inner window 140×140 pixels and outer window 200×200 pixels as effective.
